def rank_data(vals):
    n = len(vals)
    indexed = sorted(list(enumerate(vals)), key=lambda x: x[1])
    ranks = [0.0] * n
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j < n and indexed[j][1] == indexed[i][1]:
            j += 1
        avg_rank = (i + 1 + j) / 2.0
        for k in range(i, j):
            ranks[indexed[k][0]] = avg_rank
        i = j
    return ranks
y_ranks = rank_data(y_vals)
x_ranks = rank_data(x_vals)
n = len(y_ranks)

mean_x = sum(x_ranks) / n
cov = sum((y_ranks[i] - mean_y) * (x_ranks[i] - mean_x) for i in range(n)) / n
result = round(cov, 6)
